categories.main_business_segments: Daxin Materials primarily operates in three business segments: semiconductor materials, display materials, and key raw materials. The company focuses on research, design, development, manufacturing, and sales of specialty chemicals for the semiconductor and optoelectronics industries. Its product portfolio includes high-purity chemicals for wafer processing, advanced packaging materials, photoresists, alignment layers, etchants, and functional monomers for various electronic applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes chemical synthesis, process innovation, instrumentation, and AI-driven R&D. It integrates generative AI and computational science for molecular design and patent analysis, employs smart manufacturing with machine learning and image recognition for process control, and maintains comprehensive quality monitoring systems. Key technologies include high-purity chemical synthesis, nano-particle and ion purification, and advanced packaging materials development, supported by modular and standardized production strategies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Daxin serves major semiconductor manufacturers, display panel producers, and electronic materials customers globally. Its semiconductor materials cater to wafer fabrication and advanced packaging processes, while display materials are supplied to LCD and OLED panel makers. The company collaborates closely with international semiconductor and display industry leaders, targeting markets driven by AI, HPC, and next-generation display technologies such as MicroLED and flexible OLED.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with headquarters and manufacturing plants in Taichung and Taoyuan. It serves global customers, including international semiconductor and display manufacturers, and is expanding local production capabilities to support supply chain localization amid geopolitical tensions. The company also engages in partnerships and production services with international semiconductor material giants.
categories.supply_chain_position: Daxin Materials operates mainly in the upstream and midstream segments of the semiconductor and display supply chains. It produces specialty chemicals and key raw materials essential for wafer processing, advanced packaging, and display panel manufacturing. The company also develops and manufactures high-purity polymers and functional monomers, positioning itself as a critical materials supplier supporting downstream device fabrication and assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high R&D investment focusing on semiconductor materials, display materials, and key raw materials. It advances AI-driven molecular design, smart manufacturing, and quality traceability systems. Strategic R&D includes developing materials for sub-2nm semiconductor nodes, advanced packaging (Fan-out, 2.5D/3DIC), low-temperature and ESG-compliant display materials, and expanding into green energy, high-end substrates, and biomedical materials. Collaboration with global leaders and digital transformation are key themes.
categories.revenue_model: Daxin generates revenue primarily through product sales of specialty chemicals and materials to semiconductor and display manufacturers. It also provides customized production services such as synthesis, purification, and formulation for international semiconductor material companies. Revenue streams include sales of permanent and process chemicals, advanced packaging materials, and key raw materials for electronic applications.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading market position in Taiwan's display materials sector and is a major global supplier for advanced semiconductor packaging materials. It competes with international chemical material suppliers, particularly Japanese and Chinese firms in the display segment. Daxin leverages its local manufacturing advantage, strong R&D capabilities, and close customer collaboration to differentiate itself amid intense competition and supply chain localization trends.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal year 2024, Daxin reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$4.12 billion, a slight decline of 3.4% from the previous year, with operating profit around NT$607 million and net profit increasing by 9% to NT$571 million. The semiconductor materials segment nearly doubled revenue, contributing 9% of total sales, while display materials accounted for nearly 89%. The company maintains steady growth with ongoing capacity expansion and R&D investments, positioning for future revenue increases driven by semiconductor materials.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Daxin emphasizes high-purity, high-performance specialty chemicals tailored for advanced semiconductor and display manufacturing processes. Its competitive advantages include integrated chemical synthesis capabilities, AI-enhanced R&D, local production supporting supply chain resilience, and ESG-compliant low-temperature materials. The company offers comprehensive material solutions from upstream raw materials to advanced packaging, enabling customers to achieve higher product quality, process stability, and sustainability goals.
